# A tachy tasks file (Pravic): every directive is an independent
# statement, jobs run in source order, and every job is an idempotent
# "ensure" — applying this file twice changes nothing the second time.
# Generated by "tachy generate task"; run it with:
#   tachy apply <selection> <this file>

var admin = "root"                # variables, lowest precedence here

directory /tmp/tachy-demo {       # state (default directory; absent),
    mode = "0755"                 # mode, owner, group
}

file /tmp/tachy-demo/hello.txt {
    content = "managed by tachy for {{ admin }} on {{ inventory_hostname }}\n"
    mode = "0644"                 # content is templated; src copies a
                                  # file verbatim, template renders one;
                                  # owner/group need a privileged user
}

ensure "demo file exists" {        # an ensure: a command plus expectations
    run = "test -f /tmp/tachy-demo/hello.txt"
                                  # exit_status, output = "..." or
                                  # { contains = "..." } / { matches = "..." }
}

# Composition: an apply composes another tasks file at its position,
# binding variables for it.
# apply "base.pravic" {
#     env = "prod",
# }
